claims: The Outer Banks (OBX) is a 100-mile stretch of barrier islands off the North Carolina coast.
Cape Hatteras National Seashore is a key attraction of the Outer Banks.
Wright Brothers National Memorial is a key attraction of the Outer Banks.
Jockey’s Ridge is a key attraction of the Outer Banks.
Wright Brothers National Memorial is in Kill Devil Hills.
Roanoke Island is the site of the Lost Colony.
Jockey’s Ridge State Park features massive natural sand dunes.
Wild horses can be viewed in Corolla.
The peak season in the Outer Banks is summer (June–August).
Summer temperatures in the Outer Banks are in the mid-80s°F.
The Outer Banks is known for large vacation rental homes rather than hotels.
Coastal erosion is particularly notable in Buxton and Rodanthe.
Beach closures can occur in Buxton and Rodanthe due to unsafe collapsing homes.
The Outer Banks is known as the "Graveyard of the Atlantic".
The Outer Banks is famous for many shipwrecks.
The Outer Banks has museums dedicated to maritime history.
"Outer Banks" is a Netflix drama series.
The Netflix series "Outer Banks" has brought new attention to the Outer Banks area.
The fifth and final season of the Netflix series "Outer Banks" is scheduled to premiere in 2026.
Roanoke Island is home to the Elizabethan Gardens.
Roanoke Island is home to the Lost Colony outdoor drama.
Cedar Island/Ocracoke is accessible by ferry.
